main.description: Exchange a workload identity token (an OIDC JWT) for a short PDS token bound to one com.fedproxy.rbac role of one account on this PDS. Field names follow RFC 8693. Requires a DPoP proof (RFC 9449); the issued token is bound to its key. The account's record at the role's rkey must protect this PDS and name the token's iss, aud and sub, and a policy of the role must allow capability create on /xrpc/com.fedproxy.temp.oauth.exchangeToken. A subject token is exchanged at most once.

access_token.description: A JWT of typ wid+jwt: iss the PDS service DID, sub the account DID, aud the requested audience, lxm com.fedproxy.temp.oauth.approveAuthorization, act {iss, sub} of the workload, cnf.jkt of the DPoP key, at most 5 minutes and never past the subject token.
